scope: Objects candidate audit, illustrated Story detail
objects_primary_function: Historical electric substation: transformation and distribution of electricity; later cultural adaptive reuse
objects_candidate_families: period-specific voltmeter, insulators, electric distribution machinery
identified conservation-area workshop tools or museum collection with direct site provenance

objects_held_back.reason: Copper-clad roof element is an architectural detail without independent physical-object identity; belongs to site interpretation or Structures, not Objects.
Small-pane building windows are facade details; not independently sourced, identifiable historical Objects.
No source-controlled identifiable individual transformer, switchgear, period meter or tool with site provenance and object image has been confirmed.

place_card_profile_decision: No Objects collection activated; source retains no place_card_profile until another candidate collection qualifies.
image_policy: One original 900x520 non-photographic, clearly labeled SVG building-detail illustration is attached to the source-backed historical Story only. No Object identity is inferred from the artwork.
rule_review: Object must be a specific physical artifact with independent documented identity, historically relevant function and visual membership evidence; ordinary building details do not qualify. Under Næringsliv + Industri, electric equipment is the primary research lane. Missing evidence must not be hidden by art or unrelated cultural objects.
remaining_before_vferdig: Actual site-specific Objects with individual identity/provenance and preview, or documented full source-bounded exception policy
Source-backed People with appropriate illustrative/photo visuals
